items.t: One word only, enormous, hand painted, filling the top third.
A single sound effect hand lettered near the thing that made it, four letters maximum.
Two speech bubbles in the same panel, both cut off at the bubble edge, three words each.
A caption box in the bottom corner, five words, deadpan, hand lettered in capitals.
A label on one object only, as if somebody had put a sticker on it, two words.
The date, hand written, small, bottom right, nothing else.
